description: Module-level orchestrating function iterating review-summary fetches over every candidate appid, structurally mirroring fetch_app_details.
signature: def fetch_review_summaries(client: SteamReviewsClient, appids: Sequence[int], *, on_event: EventSink) -> Iterator[RawPayload]
docstring:
Fetch review summaries for every candidate appid.

Args:
    client: A SteamReviewsClient.
    appids: The candidate appids (typically the same list passed to fetch_app_details, though the two fetches are independent and either can be re-run alone against a stored run without the other, since they write to different `source` values in raw_games).
    on_event: Progress sink, same event conventions as fetch_app_details.

Yields:
    One RawPayload(source='steam_reviews', ...) per appid attempted, including failures.
postconditions: Exactly one RawPayload is yielded per input appid
Never raises for an individual app-level failure; only for budget exhaustion or an unrecoverable client-level error

edge_cases.expected_behavior: yields nothing, emits one warning event, does not raise

edge_cases.input: An appid whose review summary shows total_reviews=0
edge_cases.expected_behavior: yielded as a normal, successful RawPayload; zero reviews is valid data, not a failure
propagates RequestBudgetExceeded after yielding whatever payloads were already produced

unit_tests.name: test_empty_appids_yields_nothing
unit_tests.description: Empty input yields nothing and does not raise.
